source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: The overall incidence of vasculopathy in NF1 is estimated at 0.4-6.4%, and the incidence of cerebrovascular vasculopathy specifically at 2-5%.
